findings.title: File-only calculations open/create/migrate the default Store before calculation
findings.trigger: Run normalize-facts FILE without --db from another worker directory, or with an unusable default DB path. Same issue structurally applies to allowlisted DB-independent branches.
findings.observed: Valid normalization created data/ir-agent.sqlite3 and24tables; same valid fixture with a file at data failed before calculation.
findings.impact: Unnecessary unrelated DB filesystem/schema/legacy-presence coupling; cannot run valid file calculations when that DB path is unusable. On existing compatible DB, Store startup can perform DDL/migration/presence observations. No actual research DB was opened to claim a concrete mutation there.
findings.contract_assessment: Default --db is documented globally, but these calculation branches/documented unimported results do not consume it. Shared initialization is an implementation side effect, not an explicit requirement to access DB state for normalization. Existing CLI tests check no domain-row adoption, not no DB creation/migration.
findings.minimal_fix: Route the exact file-only/explicit-dry-run branches before creating Store and Harness. Retain existing calculation functions, flags, trusted clocks, JSON validation/output/error handling. Instantiate Store only for remaining branches. In observations file-summary skip registry creation; in contacts explicit dry-run reuse existing catalog builder/result instead of a dummy DB.

allowlist_without_default_Store.scope: Explicit valuation JSON and --price; no Store use.
Snapshot JSON calculator confirmed by current branch and docs; does NOT read live corrections, DB receipts or historical state.
Snapshot branch comparison confirmed by current branch and docs; Store-backed freeze/send remain stateful.
Explicit supplied policy/metric/source JSON, not DB candidate state.
Supplied measured-record JSON and explicit budget, not DB job history loading.
File-contained valuation/source/provenance snapshots; not current DB publicity or trusted availability certification.
Explicit probability/label input; no forecast registry binding or calibration.
Supplied raw source -> normalized bundle, distinct from quote from-source persistence.
Supplied source/review/facts plus trusted now_iso; preserve runtime-clock validation and derived-retrieval semantics. DB-independent, not necessarily time-independent.

conditional_allowlist_without_default_St.condition: args.file is truthy (the existing file-input branch); no-file summarize is DB-backed
conditional_allowlist_without_default_St.implementation_boundary: Current run creates ObservationStore(store.connection) before choosing input; it must skip registry construction for explicit file input. No evidence binding/firstsave is read from DB in this file branch.
Current Harness method returns before Store access in explicit dry-run. Normal imports and schema-dependent state merge remain DB-backed.

conditional_DB_routes.summarize_without_file: DB snapshots at as_of, including actual firstsave and classification binding

conditional_DB_routes.condition: --dry-run absent; original state merge/import is DB-backed

explicit_do_not_bypass.reason: Resolve immutable versions, RecordAvailability/PIT knowledge cutoff and saved sources.
Persisted policy/reply/source state, current corrections/thesis/price checks and history, distinct from decision FILE.
Immutable contracts, live dependency corrections, saved state and trusted runtime.
Loads stored source then ingests derived quote; normalize-quote FILE is different.
Reads persisted visibility/history; do not replace with a user JSON guess.
Uses current companies/state and writes merge atomically.

allowlist_completeness.parse_help_note: argparse --help/usage errors already terminate before Store; not a calculation-route change.

read_tests_summary.observation: Normalization/value/model/score/file-observation tests pass a temporary persistent --db and then check sources/theses remain0. They do not assert no Store opening, no schema creation, or success with unusable DB.
Shared invoke always supplies a temporary --db. Valuable persistence tests should stay stateful.
Uses --db :memory:; prevents disk DB but still constructs Store.
Saved registry lifecycle/asof tests require DB; do not move them into the file-only allowlist.

minimal_regression_acceptance: For each static allowlisted route and the two explicit conditional routes, prove Store constructor is never called; valid results and existing JSON errors remain unchanged under a pinned existing clock when needed.
normalize-facts without --db in temp cwd must not create data/SQLite/WAL sidecars; valid input must still succeed when --db points to an impossible temporary path.
Bad pure input should return the ordinary CLI validation error and leave any supplied/default DB untouched.
Persisted/PIT/current-review commands still construct/use Store and retain existing firstsave, current correction, transactional and idempotent behaviour.
--help, CLI names, argument schema, financial calculations, source IDs/metadata and trusted runtime normalization remain unchanged; no generic plugin/dispatch framework needed.

cases.type_of_failure: Default database parent data is a regular file; mkdir raises FileExistsError. This is a deterministic path nonwritability/collision, not a tested chmod/EACCES scenario.

source_evidence.meaning: Every successfully parsed operation enters mutable Store setup before actual branch/input calculation.
run also constructs Harness/store.connection before selecting a file-only branch; passing None without changing this ordering is insufficient.
Default DB parent filesystem creation happens even for a file-only calculator.
Store creation performs schema DDL, not a read-only handle.
